original.reason: It misstates the finite complement topology: proper open sets need not be finite; rather, they have finite complements. The inference that X\A is finite from A being nonempty is unsupported.

judgment.reason: It incorrectly asserts that every proper open set in the finite complement topology is finite.
It incorrectly treats proper open sets as finite, including the claim that X\A is finite merely because it is a proper open set.
It incorrectly concludes that both A and X\A are finite from their being proper open sets.
It incorrectly concludes that A and X\A are finite because they are proper open sets.
